title: Hello Moto
blurb: Hello Moto. Motorola's sung sonic logo followed the brand right through the early 2000s, back when the RAZR was the most desirable object a teenager could own and flipping one shut was a legitimate way to end a conversation. The jingle turns up as a ringtone, a handset startup chime and an advertising sting. It has aged into the same nostalgic territory as the Nokia tune, instantly placeable to a very specific handful of years. Trim to taste before setting it as anybody's ringtone.
origin: Motorola's 'Hello Moto' sonic branding, used through the 2000s.
